按转角调整时间滑块: Scale duration by turn angle slider
时间指数：0 为固定时间（默认），1 按转角等比例缩短，2 让小角度转身更快。上: Time exponent: 0 keeps a fixed duration (default), 1 scales it proportionally to the angle, and 2 makes small turns faster. The reference duration is for 180°. Only the initial turn is affected, not ongoing rotation.
预计时间表示转角释放时间；游戏完成转身仍受实际满杆速度限制。释放时间为 0 时立: Estimates describe turn release; actual in-game completion remains limited by full-stick speed. A duration of 0 submits the entire angle immediately.
